thought.text: CSRF also needs a trusted Origin/Referer. Let me add the Referer header (same origin, as a browser would send).

reasoning_content: CSRF requires Origin/Referer to be trusted. Let me add a Referer header pointing to the same origin.

action.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== POST /auth/dev-login with CSRF + Referer ===" && curl -s -i -c /tmp/cj.txt -X POST 'http://localhost:3000/auth/dev-login?returnTo=/' -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' -H 'Referer: http://localhost:3000/' 2>&1 | head -25
echo; echo "=== cookie jar ==="; cat /tmp/cj.txt
